title: Eligibility and Enrollment Manual — The RideLink Benefit Spell and Completed Trips
content:
A Non-Emergency Medical Transportation benefit runs as a spell tied to the member's Medicaid Managed Care Membership, at one RideLink level of service. This section states when it opens and closes, how trips booked beyond its end are treated, and when a leg is completed.

**Rule.** The benefit opens with the plan membership and closes on the membership's termination date; trips booked for dates after closure are cancelled by the broker and never count as no-shows. A leg is completed only on the provider's report, and a completed value-added leg uses one value-added trip.

## Statuses of a benefit

| Status | Meaning | Moves to |
|---|---|---|
| Pending assessment | Opened and awaiting the mobility assessment | Active, when the mobility assessment sets the level of service and the benefit becomes usable; closed, when the membership ends or the request is withdrawn before assessment |
| Active | Usable for trips | Suspended, when member no-shows reach the limit; closed, when the benefit ends with the membership |
| Suspended | Trips suspended after member no-shows | Active, when the suspension period ends; closed, when the benefit ends during a suspension |
| Closed | Ended | — |

Status changes are made by the system.

## Balances on a benefit

- **Value-added trips remaining:** one-way value-added trips loaded for the benefit year and not yet used or expired.
- **Reimbursement owed:** member reimbursements approved and not yet paid, in USD.

## Points of judgement

- *Hypothetical:* a membership terminates on 31 May and a trip is booked for 3 June. The broker cancels that trip, and the cancellation never counts as a member no-show.
- A leg the member says was taken is not completed until the provider reports it.
